notes: No build, no dependencies, no backend: a fresh worktree needs no setup (npm test runs Node's built-in test runner with --test-concurrency=1; Node 22+). Run the two stacks one after the other, never in parallel (the owner's Mac froze under parallel load). One page; Explore is the only tab so far, addressed by hash: #explore (areas), #explore/area/<id>, #explore/theme/<id>, #explore/idea/<id>. A fresh origin with no token shows the welcome card; add ?demo=1 (or tap 'Look around with demo ideas') to load demo/library.json, which is made up and never written to IndexedDB. idea-0a1b10 is the demo's retired idea (its theme is gone: breadcrumb Areas then idea). The Data sheet opens from the header button: token form (needs a real fine-grained token for syoon291/tane-data; never use one in tests - mock https://api.github.com/** with page.route), Reload, Unlink (confirm()), backup export/import (import uses confirm()). All data lives in IndexedDB databases 'tane' and 'tane-device' (the token), so a browser test starts empty; a different port is a different origin. The service worker registers only over https, so it never runs on localhost. CI is the Pages workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml): it runs both stacks on every PR and on main before deploying. Public repo: never put real personal data in fixtures or tests.
